messages:
katie: Quick thought — can we shift the weekly triage call 30m earlier for APAC? Current noon is killing overlap. Also want to try a 20m 'rapid triage' format and keep deep discussions async. Thoughts?

samir: +1 for earlier. 11:30PT would still work for NA. We should keep a rotating owner for backlog review.

leo: Concern: DB team has weekly stand at 11:30. Could we instead make it 11:15 and cap at 25m? :thinking_face:

mscott: we did a poll last quarter — leaning earlier. i'm ok with 11:15 if we make agenda strict.

katie: Proposed compact agenda:
```
5m - quick owner handoff (owner posts blockers)
10m - triage quick hits (<=2 tickets per owner)
10m - escalations & rollouts (only if blockers)
```
If no escalations, we end at ~15m.

samir: +1. Also propose rotating owner roster in the calendar description and add a 'backup' oncall person (in case owner is OOO).

oncall-bot: Reminder set: weekly triage meeting at 11:15 PT starting Mon Apr 4. Owner rotation: see pinned doc https://redwood.company/triage-rota :bell:

katie: I'll update the calendar invite and the agenda in the pinned doc. Can owners for next 3 weeks react with :thumbsup: by EOD?

leo: reacted :thumbsup:

mscott: +1

samir: I'll take next week. Assigned myself in the doc.

katie: thanks — updating now. If any team conflicts, ping me and we'll follow-up async.

katie: tiny follow-up: adding a bullet to the runbook to mark tickets that need postmortem if triage flagged them as Sev2+ so owners know to escalate.
